TC-01.product_overview: A simple Python greeting script that personalizes user interaction by displaying a custom greeting and the current time.

core_features.name: User Input
core_features.description: Capture user's name via input()

core_features.name: Personalized Greeting
core_features.description: Display greeting with user's name

core_features.name: Time Display
core_features.description: Show current date and time using datetime

functional_requirements.requirement: The script shall prompt the user to enter their name
The script shall display a greeting message including the user's name
The script shall display the current date and time
The script shall use the datetime library for time operations

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Output shall be clearly formatted and readable
Script shall handle empty input gracefully

TC-02.product_overview: A calculator function that performs basic arithmetic operations with proper error handling for edge cases like division by zero.

core_features.name: Arithmetic Operations
core_features.description: Support +, -, *, / operations

core_features.name: Error Handling
core_features.description: Handle division by zero and invalid operators

functional_requirements.requirement: The function shall accept two numbers and an operator parameter
The function shall support four operators: +, -, *, /
The function shall return the calculated result
The function shall handle division by zero with try-except or conditional check
The function shall return an error message for invalid operators

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Function shall never crash on invalid input
Code shall be well-documented with docstring

TC-03.product_overview: A data processing script that reads CSV files and computes statistical summaries (average, sum) for numerical columns using pandas.

core_features.name: CSV Loading
core_features.description: Read CSV file using pandas.read_csv()

core_features.name: Statistical Summary
core_features.description: Calculate sum and mean for each numerical column

core_features.name: Result Display
core_features.description: Print formatted summary to console

functional_requirements.requirement: The script shall read a CSV file named 'data.csv'
The script shall identify all numerical columns automatically
The script shall calculate and display the sum of each numerical column
The script shall calculate and display the average (mean) of each numerical column
The script shall handle missing values appropriately

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Shall efficiently process files up to 100MB
Output shall be clearly labeled by column name

TC-04.product_overview: A command-line To-Do List application with SQLite database persistence, allowing users to manage tasks through add, view, and delete operations.

core_features.name: Add Task
core_features.description: Insert new tasks into the database

core_features.name: View Tasks
core_features.description: Display all tasks from the database

core_features.name: Delete Task
core_features.description: Remove tasks by ID

functional_requirements.requirement: The application shall use sqlite3 for database operations
The application shall create a tasks table with id, description, and status columns
The application shall support adding tasks via INSERT query
The application shall display all tasks via SELECT query
The application shall delete tasks by ID via DELETE query
The application shall properly close database connections

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Database shall be created if not exists
CLI shall provide clear menu options

TC-05.product_overview: A web scraping tool that extracts heading tags (H1-H3) and hyperlinks from a specified URL and saves them to a text file.

core_features.name: HTTP Request
core_features.description: Fetch webpage content using requests library

core_features.name: Content Parsing
core_features.description: Extract H1-H3 headers and links using BeautifulSoup

core_features.name: File Export
core_features.description: Save extracted data to a text file

functional_requirements.requirement: The script shall accept a URL as input
The script shall use requests library to fetch the webpage
The script shall use BeautifulSoup (bs4) to parse HTML content
The script shall extract all H1, H2, and H3 heading tags
The script shall extract all hyperlinks (anchor tags with href)
The script shall save results to a text file with clear formatting

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Complete scraping within 10 seconds for normal pages

TC-06.product_overview: A weather data fetcher that retrieves current temperature information for a specified city from a weather API.

core_features.name: API Request
core_features.description: Fetch weather data from external API

core_features.name: JSON Parsing
core_features.description: Extract temperature from API response

core_features.name: Display Result
core_features.description: Show temperature to user

functional_requirements.requirement: The script shall accept a city name as input
The script shall use requests library to call weather API
The script shall parse JSON response from API
The script shall extract and display the temperature value
The script shall handle API errors (invalid city, rate limit)

non_functional_requirements.requirement: API key shall not be hardcoded

TC-07.product_overview: A RESTful API for a Book Store built with FastAPI, providing CRUD operations for managing book inventory.

core_features.name: Get Books
core_features.description: GET endpoint to retrieve all books

core_features.name: Get Single Book
core_features.description: GET endpoint to retrieve a book by ID

core_features.name: Add Book
core_features.description: POST endpoint to create a new book

functional_requirements.requirement: The API shall be built using FastAPI framework
The API shall have a GET /books endpoint returning all books
The API shall have a GET /books/{id} endpoint returning a specific book
The API shall have a POST /books endpoint to create new books
The API shall use @app.get and @app.post decorators
The API shall return JSON responses with proper status codes

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Use Pydantic models for request/response validation

TC-08.product_overview: A modular Python project demonstrating proper file organization with separate modules for math functions and logging utilities.

core_features.name: Math Module
core_features.description: Contains mathematical functions

core_features.name: Logging Module
core_features.description: Contains logging utilities

core_features.name: Main Module
core_features.description: Imports and uses both modules

functional_requirements.requirement: Project shall have two separate Python files (modules)
One file shall contain math function(s)
Another file shall contain logging function(s)
Main file shall import functions from both modules using import statement
The application shall demonstrate calling functions from both modules
Imports shall use correct relative or absolute import syntax

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Each module shall have a clear single responsibility
Functions shall have descriptive names and docstrings
